checks.name: public HTTPS GET with TLS validation and exact approved SHA256
fresh startup and navigation without horizontal overflow
no console errors, exceptions, rejected promises or backend attempts

limitations: Public smoke test used a fresh credential-free profile; authenticated Firebase, Drive, GitHub and paid AI operations were intentionally outside this public check.
Unnecessary third-party fonts were locally fulfilled without external font downloads; this does not verify their live availability.
Public-origin browser verification used Chromium on Linux; earlier isolated browser suites covered Firefox/WebKit, but this public smoke did not test physical devices.
